text_en: While they were at Hazeroth, Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married (for he had indeed married a Cushite woman);
text_cn: 米黎盎和亚郎为了梅瑟所娶的雇士女人出言反对梅瑟，因为他娶了个雇士女人，

text_en: and they said, “Has the Lord spoken only through Moses? Has he not spoken through us also? ” And the Lord heard it.
text_cn: 于是说：“上主岂只与梅瑟交谈，不是也与我们交谈过！”上主听见了这话。

text_en: Now the man Moses was very humble, more so than anyone else on the face of the earth.
text_cn: 梅瑟为人十分谦和，超过地上所有的人。

text_en: Suddenly the Lord said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, “Come out, you three, to the tent of meeting. ” So the three of them came out.
text_cn: 上主忽然向梅瑟、亚郎和米黎盎说：“你们三人到会幕那里去。”他们三人就去了。

text_en: Then the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the entrance of the tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.
text_cn: 上主乘云柱降下，停在会幕门口，叫亚郎和米黎盎；他们两人就走向前去，

text_en: And he said, “Hear my words: When there are prophets among you, I the Lord make myself known to them in visions; I speak to them in dreams.
text_cn: 上主说：“你们听我说：若你们中有一位是先知，我要在神视中显示给他，在梦中与他谈话；

text_en: Not so with my servant Moses; he is entrusted with all my house.
text_cn: 但对我的仆人梅瑟却不是这样，他在我全家中是最忠信可靠的。

text_en: With him I speak face to face— clearly, not in riddles; and he beholds the form of the Lord . Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses? ”
text_cn: 我面对面与他明明说话，不藉谜语，并让他望见上主的形像。为什么你们竟不怕出言反对我的仆人梅瑟？”

text_en: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against them, and he departed.
text_cn: 上主对他们发着怒走了。

text_en: When the cloud went away from over the tent, Miriam had become leprous, as white as snow. And Aaron turned towards Miriam and saw that she was leprous.
text_cn: 彩云一离开会幕，看，米黎盎就生了癞病，像雪那样白；亚郎转身看见米黎盎生了癞病，

text_en: Then Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, do not punish us for a sin that we have so foolishly committed.
text_cn: 遂对梅瑟说：“我主，恳求你，别使我们因一时愚昧所犯之罪而受罚！

text_en: Do not let her be like one stillborn, whose flesh is half consumed when it comes out of its mother’s womb. ”
text_cn: 求你别让她像个胎死腹中的人，一出娘胎，肉身就已腐烂了一半。”

text_en: And Moses cried to the Lord , “O God, please heal her. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟遂向上主呼求说：“天主，我求你治好她吧！”

text_en: But the Lord said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, would she not bear her shame for seven days? Let her be shut out of the camp for seven days, and after that she may be brought in again. ”
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“若她的父亲在她面上吐唾沫，她岂不要七天忍此羞辱，七天把她隔离在营外，然后才让她回来？”

text_en: So Miriam was shut out of the camp for seven days; and the people did not set out on the march until Miriam had been brought in again.
text_cn: 于是米黎盎七天之久，被隔离在营外；民众也没有起程，直到米黎盎回来。

text_en: After that the people set out from Hazeroth, and camped in the wilderness of Paran.
text_cn: 以后，民众由哈兹洛特起程出发，在帕兰旷野扎了营。
